title: Cloud SQL: Workload Capture `backupId` Read-Only; New Instance Controls
summary: The `backupId` field in `WorkloadCapture` is now read-only, requiring updates for any code attempting to set it. Additionally, `DatabaseInstance` gains new controls for Database Center integration and major version upgrade prechecks.
details:
The `backupId` property within the `WorkloadCapture` schema has been made read-only. This is a breaking change; developers should ensure their applications no longer attempt to write to this field. This change aligns with the ongoing refinement of Workload Capture schemas, enhancing immutability.

Furthermore, `DatabaseInstance` now includes a `databaseCenterIntegration` field, allowing explicit control over Database Center integration, which is enabled by default. For major version upgrades, a new `skipPrecheck` boolean field has been added to `DatabaseInstance` to bypass pre-upgrade checks, and `PreCheckMajorVersionUpgradeContext` now supports `maxRuntime` to limit precheck duration. Finally, the `WorkloadCaptureState` enum has a new `TERMINATED` value, indicating automatically stopped captures.
